description: Use when the user asks about weather warnings, watches or advisories (storms, floods, heat, winter, fire weather) for a US place right now. Give lat + lon for a point, or a 2-letter state code; nothing returns the most severe alerts nationwide. "No active alerts" is not a forecast.

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 15 calls free within 48 hours).

name: weather_alerts
title: Active US weather warnings (NWS)
